title: Capital One unveils 3 limited-time card offers: Earn up to $250 in bonus cash back
raw_text:
Capital One has unveiled limited-time welcome offers for three of its cash-back cards: the Capital One Savor Cash Rewards Credit Card, Capital One Savor Student Cash Rewards Credit Card and Capital One Quicksilver Student Cash Rewards Credit Card.
These offers aren't huge, but it's rare to have increased intro bonuses for these cards — especially the student cards. Outside the welcome bonuses, these are some of the best credit cards for students and for earning cash back.
The Capital One Savor card has no annual fee and a valuable intro APR offer, but what makes it stand out is its bonus categories. You'll earn 3% cash back at grocery stores and on entertainment, dining and streaming services.
Its current $250 bonus is easy to earn and only requires you to spend $500 in purchases within the first three months from account opening. That's the exact spending requirement for the card's previous offer, which was only worth $200.
The Capital One Savor Cash Rewards Credit Card is one of the most rewarding options for earning cash back in categories such as entertainment and dining without paying an annual fee. Plus, you can combine its rewards with Capital One's travel cards to convert them into transferable miles.
- One of the most rewarding cash back cards for entertainment and streaming services
- No annual fee
- Easy-to-earn welcome bonus
- High APR
- Requires a good to excellent credit score
Highlights shown here are provided by the issuer and have not been reviewed by CNBC Select's editorial staff.
- For a limited time, earn a one-time $250 cash bonus once you spend $500 on purchases within the first 3 months from account opening
- $0 annual fee and no foreign transaction fees
- Earn unlimited 3% cash back at grocery stores (excluding superstores like Walmart® and Target®), on dining, entertainment and popular streaming services, plus 1% on all other purchases
- Earn 8% cash back on Capital One Entertainment purchases
- Earn unlimited 5% cash back on hotels, vacation rentals and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel
- No rotating categories or sign-ups needed to earn cash rewards; plus cash back won't expire for the life of the account and there's no limit to how much you can earn
- 0% intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for 12 months; 18.74% - 28.74% variable APR after that; balance transfer fee applies
- Top rated mobile app
Introductory fee of 3% of the amount of each transferred balance that posts to your account during the first 12 months that your account is open. After that, 4% of the amount of each transferred balance that posts to your account at a promotional APR that we may offer you at any other time.
This is a great standalone card because it earns additional rewards in two popular categories (dining and groceries) and in categories that fewer cards offer bonus rewards for (entertainment and streaming services). It's also great to have if you pair it with a card like the Capital One Venture Rewards Credit Card or Capital One Venture X Rewards Credit Card, because you can combine your rewards. That means the cash back you earn with the Savor card can be converted into transferable Capital One miles.
The Capital One Venture Rewards Credit Card has a reasonable annual fee and earns flexible travel rewards, which makes it a great travel card for beginners or heavy travelers.
- Valuable welcome offer worth at least $750 in travel
- You can transfer miles to over 15 Capital One partners, including Emirates Skywards, Choice Privileges and Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer
- No foreign transaction fees
- Lacks ongoing travel benefits such as statement credits or lounge access
- Limited bonus spending category that only applies to certain Capital One Travel bookings
Highlights shown here are provided by the issuer and have not been reviewed by CNBC Select's editorial staff.
- Earn a one-time bonus of 75,000 miles once you spend $4,000 on purchases within 3 months from account opening, equal to $750 in travel
- Earn unlimited 2X miles on every purchase, every day
- Earn 5X miles on hotels, vacation rentals and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel
- Miles won't expire for the life of the account and there's no limit to how many you can earn
- Receive up to a $120 credit for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck®
- Use your miles to get reimbursed for any travel purchase—or redeem by booking a trip through Capital One Travel
- Enjoy a $50 experience credit and other premium benefits with every hotel and vacation rental booked from the Lifestyle Collection
- Transfer your miles to your choice of 15+ travel loyalty programs
- Top rated mobile app
$0 at the Transfer APR, 4% of the amount of each transferred balance that posts to your account at a promotional APR that Capital One may offer to you
None
If you're a college student, opening a student credit card can be a good way to start establishing credit history. However, credit cards designed for students and others with little-to-no credit history also tend to be far less rewarding. Many of these cards offer no rewards at all.
Capital One bucks that trend with its Quicksilver Student and Savor Student cards. Surprisingly, both earn cash back at the same rate as their non-student counterparts. The Quicksilver Student card earns 1.5% cash back on all purchases, and the Savor Student card earns 3% cash back on dining, entertainment, streaming services and at grocery stores.
They also each feature a welcome bonus, which is, again, rare for a student credit card. Both cards currently offer a $100 cash bonus after you spend $300 on the card within the first three months. That's a $50 increase from the last bonus, but with the same spending requirement.
If you're a student, you'll have a difficult time finding a credit card you'll qualify for that is more valuable than either of these options.
The Capital One Quicksilver Student Credit Card earns a generous 1.5% cash back on every purchase, which makes it one of the most rewarding credit cards that's available to students.
- Simple rewards structure with no caps or categories to track
- No annual fee
- Potentially high APR
Highlights shown here are provided by the issuer and have not been reviewed by CNBC Select's editorial staff.

The Capital One Savor Student Cash Rewards Credit Card is a card designed for students with rewards rates that match many of the top cash-back credit cards.
